revisions.title: 8-line line-heuristic raises scan
revisions.rationale: Legacy immunity gate used a fixed 8-line-ahead heuristic to detect {.raises: ...} annotations near proc/func declarations. This approach produced false positives (attributing a nearby pragma from an unrelated declaration) and false negatives (missing pragmas beyond 8 lines or in multi-line headers). The measurement was configuration-dependent and non-deterministic across platforms.

revisions.title: AST-semantic source-visible projection
revisions.rationale: Replaced the 8-line distance heuristic with AST-semantic source-text parsing. Compliance is determined by whether the effective effect environment at the declaration point carries an explicit raises contract — either via declaration-local inline pragma (parsed by header token sequence) or file-scope push/pop raises nesting. No branch selection for when/when defined() blocks; all source-visible eligible declarations are counted. Include'd file declarations are attributed to the including file. Deterministic output: same input produces byte-identical JSON.
